identitySignals: Exact name match: 'Discovery Ranch South' is a residential treatment center and therapeutic school for teen girls in Utah (discoveryranchsouth.com)
Agenda gives Springville, UT; a company database lists 'Discovery Ranch South, Inc.' with headquarters in Springville, UT, while the campus itself is near Cedar City, UT
Website describes accredited academics and clinical treatment for teens with emotional and behavioral needs, consistent with an OUSD nonpublic school special education placement contract

Sister program 'Discovery Ranch' (Mapleton, UT) and 'Discovery Ranch for Girls' appear in the California Department of Education school directory as certified nonpublic schools, consistent with California districts placing students there
research.notes: Agenda location (Springville, UT) matches the company database headquarters, but the campus and the website's address are in Cedar City, UT. Legal name and headquarters rest on a third-party company database (privco), not a state registry; Utah business registry was not checked. The address shown is the campus address, not the Springville headquarters. No EIN, entity number or UEI found.

profile.summary: Discovery Ranch South is a residential treatment center for teenage girls in southern Utah. It combines individual, group and family therapy, outdoor and animal-assisted activities, and accredited school classes taught by licensed teachers.
